findings.evidence_snippet: FROM node:24 AS installer
findings.recommended_mitigation_title: Pin base image to @sha256:<digest>
findings.scenario: Unpinned Container Base Image: Tag-only base images (FROM node:24) can be silently substituted by a malicious publisher. Digest-pinning (@sha256:…) ensures the exact image bytes are used on every build.
findings.title: Unpinned Container Base Image

findings.evidence_snippet: job lint: no permissions at job or workflow level
findings.recommended_mitigation_title: Add `permissions: { contents: read }` at workflow root; elevate per-job only where needed
findings.scenario: Missing Workflow Permissions Block: Without an explicit permissions block at workflow or job level, the job inherits the repository default (commonly write-all) for GITHUB_TOKEN — any compromised step can push code, create releases, or approve PRs.
findings.title: Missing Workflow Permissions Block

findings.evidence_snippet: uses: coverallsapp/github-action@v2
findings.recommended_mitigation_title: Pin every third-party action to a full 40-char commit SHA
findings.scenario: Unpinned Third-Party GitHub Action: Tag-based action references (@v3, @main) are mutable — a compromised publisher can retroactively inject malicious code into an already-used tag.
findings.title: Unpinned Third-Party GitHub Action

findings.recommended_mitigation_title: Add cosign signing step to release workflow; or use actions/attest-build-provenance
findings.scenario: Missing Container Image Signing: Unsigned container images cannot be verified for provenance — any registry intermediary could substitute them.
findings.title: Missing Container Image Signing

findings.evidence_snippet: File not found
findings.recommended_mitigation_title: Commit package-lock.json; use `npm ci` in CI
findings.scenario: Missing npm Lockfile: Without a lockfile, `npm install` installs different transitive versions on each run — supply-chain attacks become undetectable.
findings.title: Missing npm Lockfile

findings.evidence_snippet: "postinstall": "cd frontend && npm install && cd .. && npm run build:frontend && (npm run --silent build:server || cd .)",
findings.recommended_mitigation_title: Remove postinstall if possible; else document why required and use --ignore-scripts in CI and audit the hook content
findings.scenario: Unaudited npm Lifecycle Script: postinstall hooks execute arbitrary code at install time — the attack surface for supply-chain compromise.
findings.title: Unaudited npm Lifecycle Script
